description: SDMX library  .A common library and programming API for working with SDMX data and structural metadata. This is a port from Java of Eurostat's fork of Metadata Technologies SdmxSource v1.1.4.
releaseNotes:
# Changelog

## sdmxsource.net v10.10.0 (2025-12-01)

### Details v10.10.0

### Tickets v10.10.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2859: Revert supporting storing both draft/final versions of the same artefact
- SDMXRI-2711: Support for  the specific Cross Sectional Census hub data with no time dimension in NSI Client frontend
- SDMXRI-2812: Small performance fixes in retrieving of structures
- SDMXRI-2233: SDMXRI.NET retrieve/persist ValueList (SDMX3.0,ValueList)
- SDMXRI-2837: Cleanup estat_sdmxsource_extension

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2833: Uploading non final codelist is changed into final codelist
- SDMXRI-2838: RE: Issue in the Estat.SdmxSource.SdmxDataParser library (ver. 10.4)
- SDMXRI-2829: Hierarchical referential metadata attributes not returned


## sdmxsource.net v10.8.0 (2025-08-08)

### Tickets v10.8.0

- SDMXRI-2241: SDMXRI.NET retrieve/persist MetadataProvisionAgreement
- SDMXRI-2413: Persist and use SDMX version of imported artefacts .NET
- SDMXRI-2574: .NET Support REST 2.1 sort Data Query Parameter
- SDMXRI-2645: Minor changes to asOf parameter in NSIWS .NET
- SDMXRI-2723: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.7.0-(2025-06-23)
- SDMXRI-2741: NL-CBS memory consumption

### Details v10.8.0

1. Performance improvements
1. Use SDMX Standard to determine which structures are not compatible with requests


## sdmxsource.net v10.7.0 (2025-06-23)

### Tickets v10.7.0

- SDMXRI-2570: Update c Data Query Parameter according to new REST 2.1 documentation
- SDMXRI-2243: retrieve/persist RepresentationMap
- SDMXRI-2245: retrieve/persist Hierarchy
- SDMXRI-2246: retrieve/persist HierarchyAssociation
- SDMXRI-2569 Data url to support SDMX 3.1 offset and limit parameters
- SDMXRI-2698 Empty measures in the json v2 data response's structures section
- SDMXRI-2707 Dimensiongroup attributes written both in structure and data part (not using the index)
- SDMXRI-2691 Improve performance of csv retrieval of culture specific decimal separators
- SDMXRI-2706 when useHierarchicalCodelists option is used and Component doesn't have HierarchicalCodelist attached fallback to ordinal Codelist hierarchy when writing "parents" not in json

### Details v10.7.0

1. Allow multiple datasets for multiple dataflows in csv20 data writer 
1. Fixes for DimensionAtObservation requests
1. Fix issues with unbound max occurs and default header when Accept header is null or empty

## sdmxsource.net v10.6.0 (2025-05-12)

### Tickets v10.6.0

- SDMXRI-2491: SdmxSource .NET SDMX-ML-3.0.0 metadataset reader
- SDMXRI-2244: SDMXRI.NET retrieve/persist StructureMap

### Details v10.6.0

1. Fixed bug for REST requests with dimensionAtObservation = 'All' 
1. Fixed bug with json content constraint reader v2 reading the date wrong on linux
1. Fixed issue with CompactDataReaderEngine not being able to handle Footer node
1. Ignore 'limit' and 'offset' parameters until the backend implementation

## sdmxsource.net v10.5.0 (2025-04-08)

### Tickets v10.5.0

- SDMXRI-2617: Fix data queries with attributes=msd measures=none
- SDMXRI-2510: MAWS.NET : Support 2 URL for NSIWS for data and structure
- SDMXRI-2240: SDMXRI.NET retrieve/persist Metadataflow
- SDMXRI-2625: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.4.0-(2025-02-27)
- SDMXRI-2649: Wrong Allowed CC version used in data extractions when the DF version is omitted
- SDMXRI-2633: Update the documentation of SDMXSource .NET

### Details v10.5.0

1. Fixed bug where non final structure(dataflow:ESTAT:SSTSCONS_PROD_M:2.4.3-draft) would show as final in data responses
1. Backend support 2 URL for NSIWS for data and structure
1. Update and improve documentation(it has been moved to .md format)
1. Handle better values when importing and parsing structure files

## sdmxsource.net v10.4.0 (2025-02-27)

### Tickets v10.4.0

- SDMXRI-2608: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.3.0-(2024-12-06)
- SDMXRI-2605: SDMX-JSON Data 2.0.0 writer Multiple measure, array values
- SDMXRI-2363: Use native json writer methods to escape observation value for non-numerical measure

## sdmxsource.net v10.3.0 (2024-12-06)

### Details v10.3.0

1. Bring back support for .NET Standard 2.0 which includes .NET Framework 4.8
1. Improved support for DataSetKey
1. Many changes from the OECD were included in this release
1. SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 improvements
   1. Allow SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 to be returned with SDMX REST 1 as long there are no SDMX 3.0.0 specific features
   1. Support reading SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 with multiple structures
   1. Improved `labels=name` support
   1. Extra validity columns when requesting historic data
1. Improve support for SDMX-JSON 2.0.0 Structure
   1. Data Provider support
   1. Data Constraint support
   1. Improve stub support (reading/writing)
1. SDMX-ML 3.0.0 Do not write DataSet constraint attachment since it is not supported
